ctx.x: At least I’ve got to get my new FBI. It will take a long – a lot of place to put it in.
Have you been following the case of Tarik Shaw?
That’s a very interesting case. He’s a musician who’s apparently well regarded by musicians. So far as I can tell, he is in the position he is – I think he’s still in solitary confinement . . .
